about: classes: the only classes an object can end up in (the client's Excel asset classes); anything else that is real is unclassified. prompts: SigLIP's prompt ensemble per class (each prompt in every template). size_m: the plausible longest side in metres (pipeline/plausibility.py), size_why its basis. shape: optional limits on the thinnest side and on longest/middle side, shape_why their basis. detector_prompts and other_prompts: the things an object can be instead of a class (main's OWLv2 list; this branch uses them for SigLIP only).

classes.name: pump
prompts: inline circulator pump on a pipe
types: grey pump with a digital display
classes.size_why: inline circulators are ~0.2-0.4 m, a pump with its motor up to ~0.9 m
classes.shape_why: a pump unit's thinnest side is a casing several cm deep; no elongation limit: splat boxes come out front-heavy and elongated, and a 3x limit dropped real inline pumps

classes.name: motor
classes.size_why: small fan-cooled motors ~0.2 m to ~0.8 m frames

classes.name: valve
classes.size_why: ball valves from ~5 cm; a flanged valve with its actuator or handwheel ~0.5 m
classes.shape_why: a valve body with its actuator or handwheel is compact; a part much longer than it is wide is a pipe or a stem

classes.name: pressure transmitter
classes.size_why: dial gauges are 6-16 cm across, transmitters ~0.1-0.2 m
